target: unchanged target_union_minus_baseline from Phase 9 label Parquet
sampling: all positive cells plus 3:1 sampled negatives, stratified by block, all fitted within training fold

block_bootstrap_pr_auc_ci_95.method: resample entire 3 km blocks with replacement

uncertainty.method: 90% split-conformalized absolute-error band using cross-fitted Platt probabilities from inner buffered training blocks; outer test blocks assess empirical coverage.
uncertainty.caveat: Spatial autocorrelation weakens exchangeability assumptions. The band is for the binary label probability response, not water-depth uncertainty.

inner_split_method: Two geographically contiguous block-row halves; choose the cut that best balances cells while retaining both classes after the same one-block buffer. The two inner validation halves partition each outer training set.
